mintAuthority.summary: pUSD is a Nucleus BoringVault (non-upgradeable) on both Ethereum and Plume; owner()=3-of-6 Plume Safe (0xa08a…) on both chains; a RolesAuthority (0x97bc…, same Safe as owner) gates enter(). Teller at 0x41bdb4 (Plume) is the OFAC-gated deposit gateway confirmed by live mint transactions.

controls.label: BoringVault Safe owner (3-of-6)
controls.evidence: Reverified by CurM16cNGN on 2026-10-01 at pinned Ethereum block 26096009 and Plume block 96626677: BoringVault and RolesAuthority owners remain Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982. Both Safes are 3-of-6 with the listed signer set, no enabled modules, zero guard storage, fallback handler 0x017062a1de2fe6b99be3d9d37841fed19f573804 and masterCopy 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea. The previous signer 0x315e376ca228d8e1376cccad2abb0b4aa8a77f3a is absent; current signer 0x0fcabe7b2410d31d9516ac27d2992f040a1b29a9 is present. The vault implementation, admin and beacon EIP-1967 slots remain zero and authority() remains 0x97bc6151fc501e6e2ec2acba3d4261d4bc7a6f90 on both chains. No signer key-custody or fallback-handler safety claim is made.

controls.label: Nucleus Teller (Plume deposit gateway)
controls.evidence: At Plume block 74171811 (2026-06-11), live mint transactions (e.g. 0xcf58692fa0f5…) showed callers invoking 0x41bdb4aa4a63a5b2efc531858d3118392b1a1c3d (Teller, 2304 bytes) which in turn triggered Transfer-from-zero on the BoringVault. The Teller is the OFAC-gated predicate proxy deposit gateway; RolesAuthority owned by same 3-of-6 Safe controls which addresses can call enter().

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531116 and Plume block 81049017 (2026-07-14), the pUSD BoringVault at 0xdddd… has zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots on both tracked deployments, confirming an immutable mint-critical vault. owner() remains the 3-of-6 GnosisSafeL2 at 0xa08a… with no enabled modules; authority() remains RolesAuthority 0x97bc…, owned by the same Safe. The Plume Teller at 0x41bdb4aa remains the deposit gateway and is the only reviewed direct mint route. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the undelayed owner Safe can replace authorized enter callers, while the live reserve configuration covers Ethereum only and the repo names no prudential supervisor or independent attestor. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: Wave 2 external research verified EO's independent on-chain proof-of-reserves service for pUSD, but no public feed scope reconciles both tracked pUSD deployments, so reconciliation remains unknown. Wave 1 reconciliation research 2026-08-15: EO's public Plume directory lists a pUSD/USD price feed with a 24-hour heartbeat, while EO's Plume announcement says pUSD benefits from proof-of-reserves/on-chain NAV without publishing a reserve-to-liability scope covering both Ethereum and Plume pUSD supplies; no dated recurring whole-supply reconciliation was found.
